envelope.description: Route trivial work to the issue stage

body.title: Route trivial work to the issue stage
body.summary: routeForSizeClass('trivial') returns startStage 'issue'; buildNextCall starts the issue workflow with sizeClass trivial, magnitude small, kind change (and kind defect for a bugfix); no tier starts at build.
acceptanceChecks: Triage of a trivial request returns an issue-workflow nextCall with kind change and magnitude small.
No size class routes to build.
A trivial change runs issue, approval, build and BUILD approval and its Story completes.

tests.name: routeForSizeClass: trivial routes to the issue stage with no LLD
routeForSizeClass: no tier starts at build
triage nextCall: trivial starts the issue workflow with sizeClass trivial, magnitude small and kind change
a trivial change: ISSUE approved, build under its hash, BUILD approved completes STORY and EPIC
